purpose: machine-readable discovery of bounded educational-content research tasks

task_contract.academic_authority: official teaching material available to the production project
task_contract.objective: Test a bounded educational-content quality claim without treating external assertions as academic authority.
allowed_actions: submit sanitized minimal fixtures or counterexamples
propose deterministic ambiguity, distractor, coverage, or validator tests
forbidden_actions: publish official course PDFs or answer keys
write directly to the Repàs Actiu production corpus
submit private student data or credentials
override official teaching material with general-knowledge claims
task_contract.completion_condition: The submission gives a deterministic check or falsifier that can be independently reviewed against the permitted evidence and official-material boundary.
